look: Sathya's B&W collage reel series (copied from their reference video): white paper texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spotlight / soft light; their halftone sticker cut-outs pinned with soft drop shadows; AI for Real Life brand accents: pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD (their logo); pro camera rig with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins, whip-ins/outs, match-cut zooms and roll transitions; AI for Real Life logo end card; camera travels through a tall world (pushes, tilts, whips with motion blur), Morven kicker over a huge Allenoire headline with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes and stamps, hand-drawn pink marks, torn-paper B&W stock clips, glitch blocks at cuts. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, every beat timed to Sathya's voice-over (Reel_03.mp3, 70.1 s), text kept inside the Reels safe zone.

scenes.name: China vs the world
scenes.desc: Robots drop onto China's pan of an antique scale until it outweighs the flags of the rest of the world.
354,000 counts up over a China map; the camera tilts to 59% and a 10×10 grid fills 59 pink cells.

scenes.name: US passes Japan
scenes.desc: Flagged bar rows: the US bar overtakes Japan and the rows swap; stamped NOW NO. 2; 38,400 and +12% tape.

scenes.name: Car plants?
scenes.desc: You'd guess car plants: a robot sticker and a question mark, then a B&W car-factory clip; Automotive, 13,500, −1%.

scenes.name: Food & drink +30%
scenes.desc: Whip to a B&W bottling-line clip; Food & drink tape and a +30% stamp.

scenes.name: Speeding up
scenes.desc: Pull back to a world map with pink pins; tilt to 603,000 new robots installed worldwide in 2025.

scenes.name: 5,000,000 running
scenes.desc: A grid of robot stickers fills while 5,000,000 counts up; stamped MORE THAN DOUBLE vs seven years ago.

scenes.name: 806,000 by 2029
scenes.desc: Forecast bars: 2025 solid, 2026 and 2029 dashed (655k, 806k) with a pink trend line.

scenes.name: What's driving it
scenes.desc: A paper eye with blue targeting brackets and a scan line: AI + machine vision, then Labour shortages.

scenes.name: Off the screen
scenes.desc: A robot arm climbs out of a laptop screen, then the screen tears open into a real factory clip.

scenes.name: −68,000 jobs
scenes.desc: US factory jobs −68,000 (Dec 2024 to Dec 2025) as three workers fade and walk off; an easy headline: Robots took the jobs?

scenes.name: Tariffs, 8 months
scenes.desc: Port clip with ship and containers stamped TARIFFS (April 2025), then eight month boxes May–Dec crossed out in pink.

scenes.name: Two lines
scenes.desc: A blue robots line rises and a pink jobs line falls; a magnifier sweeps; stamped NOT PROOF.

scenes.name: Check what else happened
scenes.desc: Check what else happened: a calendar under a circling magnifier, pink question marks, a Tariffs tag.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
